title: Python Lists
description: Lists are used to store multiple items in a single variable.

challenges.title: Create List
challenges.exercise: Create a list named 'fruits' with 'apple', 'banana', 'cherry'. Print it.

challenges.title: Access Item
challenges.exercise: Print the second item in the fruits list.

challenges.title: Change Item
challenges.exercise: Change 'apple' to 'kiwi' and print the list.

challenges.title: List Length
challenges.exercise: Print the number of items in the fruits list using len().

challenges.title: Remove Item
challenges.exercise: Remove 'banana' using the remove() method and print the list.
